source: 675 Evil
target: 675 Malum

source: In a few swift strides, Rhea positioned herself behind the slaves, raised her right foot, and delivered a powerful kick.
target: Paucis rapidis gradibus, Rhea se post servos constituit, pedem dextrum levavit, et validum calcitrum dedit.

source: With a resounding bang, the slave pressing down on the mixed‐blood lady’s maid was sent flying, landing unceremoniously in the bushes at the garden’s edge.
target: Fragore sonoro, servus qui ancillam mulieris sanguine mixti premebat, proiectus est et sine caerimoniis in fruticibus ad limitem horti cecidit.

source: The other three abruptly turned to face Rhea.
target: Tres reliqui subito se converterunt ad Rhea.

source: Before they could get a clear look at their assailant, Rhea followed up with a fluid roundhouse kick, knocking another one to the ground.
target: Antequam hostem suum clare conspexissent, Rhea calcitro circumacto fluido secundo ictu alterum in terram deiecit.

source: The remaining two, torn between greed, desire, and fear, took one look at Rhea and turned tail, fleeing to another part of the manor.
target: Reliqui duo, inter avaritiam, cupiditatem, et timorem divisi, unum intuitum in Rhea dederunt et celeriter confugerunt ad aliam partem villae.

source: Rhea retracted her left foot and fixed a cold stare upon the two servants struggling to their feet.
target: Rhea pedem sinistrum retrotraxit et frigidum aspectum duobus servis, qui ad surrectum conabantur, impositum habuit.

source: She raised her hunting bow, nocking an arrow with a smooth, practiced motion.
target: Arcum venatorium attollit et, motu leni atque exercitato, sagittam in funem inseruit.

source: The two servants licked their lips in unison.
target: Duo servi labia simul lambuerunt.

source: Unwilling but fearful, they swiftly clambered over the bushes and vanished into the garden.
target: Inviti sed timidi, celeriter super fruticos scandiderunt et in hortum evanuerunt.

source: Only then did Rhea lower her gaze to the mixed‐blood lady’s maid, whose face was still streaked with tears and confusion.
target: Tunc tantum Rhea oculos suos deiecit in ancillam mulieris sanguine mixti, cuius facies adhuc lacrimis et confusione tincta erat.

source: “Are you all right?”
target: “Esne bene?”

source: The mixed‐blood lady’s maid shook her head repeatedly.
target: Ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti caput iterum atque iterum concutiebat.

source: With trembling hands, she hastily tidied her half‐torn dress and retrieved a dagger that had fallen beside her.
target: Manibus tremulis, vestem dimidium laceratam festinanter retexuit et pugionem, qui ad eam caderat, arripuit.

source: Seeing this, Rhea wasted no time.
target: Hoc videns, Rhea nullum tempus perdidit.

source: “Find a secluded corner and hide until dawn.”
target: “Inveni angulum solitarium et absconde te usque ad auroram.”

source: With that, Rhea pivoted on her heel and prepared to dash back to where Louis Berry, Camus, and the others stood waiting at the door of the manor’s main building.
target: Hoc facto, Rhea in calcaneo vertit et se comparavit ad reditum celerem ad locum ubi Louis Berry, Camus, et ceteri ad ostium domus praecipuae villae exspectabant.

source: As the mixed‐blood lady’s maid stood up, her expression darkened, and she raised the dagger clutched in her hand, plunging it towards Rhea’s back.
target: Dum ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti surrexit, vultus eius obscuratus est, et pugionem, quam manu tenebat, in tergum Rheae immisit.

source: Catching sight of the impending danger, Camus shouted, “Watch out!”
target: Periculum imminentem conspecto, Camus exclamat: “Cave!”

source: Though Rhea hadn’t sensed the approaching threat, she instinctively heeded Camus’s warning and reacted.
target: Rhea, quamquam minam non sensit, instinctu Camus monitionem secuta est et actuata est.

source: Surrendering to inertia, she fell forward and rolled to the side, narrowly evading the dagger’s deadly path.
target: Sub imperio inertiae, prorsus cecidit et ad latus convoluta est, angustissime iter letale pugionis vitans.

source: As she rolled, Rhea pivoted to face her attacker, eyes narrowing as she instinctively raised her bow, aiming at the mixed‐blood lady’s maid.
target: Dum volvit, Rhea se convertere ad oppugnantem suum, oculis contrahentibus, instinctu arcum suum attoluit, ancillam mulieris sanguine mixti in scopum habens.

source: The mixed‐blood lady’s maid brandished her dagger, shouting in Intisian, her words laced with hatred, “Why can you join the patrol team, while I’m stuck as a mere lady’s maid? Don’t we both hail from the Southern Continent?”
target: Ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti pugionem extollens, Intisiano loquens, verbis odii infusis ait: “Cur tibi licet in cohortem speculatorum se coniungere, cum ego solum ancilla maneam? Nonne et uterque e Continente Australi orimur?”

source: “Why? I even have Intisian blood coursing through my veins!”
target: “Cur? Etiam sanguis Intisianus in venis meis fluit!”

source: Before she could complete her tirade, a crimson Fire Raven, its hue bordering on white, swooped in from nowhere, colliding with the steel dagger.
target: Antequam suam disceptationem complere posset, Corvus igniferus ruber, cuius color ad album quasi perveniebat, ex nusquam volavit et pugionem ex ferro concursans percussit.

source: With a resounding clang, the dagger heated up, an explosive force wrenching it from the mixed‐blood lady’s maid’s grasp, sending it flying several meters before clattering to the ground.
target: Fragore sonoro, pugio calefactus est; vis explosiva eum ex manu ancillae mulieris sanguine mixti eripuit, et per nonnullos metra volitantem ad terram cecidit.

source: The mixed‐blood lady’s maid faltered, fear supplanting the hatred in her eyes.
target: Ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti vacillavit, metus odium in oculis eius subvertens.

source: Lumian, his black hair and green eyes striking, stood on the steps of the manor’s main house, one hand casually tucked in his pocket.
target: Lumian, capillis nigris et oculis viridibus eminenter fulgentibus, in gradibus domus principalis villae stetit, manum unam leviter in marsupio posuit.

source: He called out, his voice carrying, “Where is Miss Amandina?”
target: Clamavit, vocem suam proferens: “Ubi est Domina Amandina?”

source: Uh… A pang of embarrassment struck Camus.
target: Heu… Camus rubore affectus est.

source: In his haste to rescue Miss Amandina, he had acted with a distinct lack of professionalism!
target: In festinatione ut Domina Amandina servaret, egit cum manifesta carentia professionalitatis!

source: He had been a guest at Palm Manor, but he had never been invited to visit Amandina’s room upstairs.
target: Fuit hospes in Palm Manerio, sed numquam invitatus est ut conclave Amandinae in superiore videret.

source: Consequently, he found himself unsure of which floor and room to search for her later.
target: Consequenter, incertus fuit quo pavimento et conclave eam postea quaerendum esse eligeret.

source: If he were to search floor by floor, he would undoubtedly encounter countless obstacles amidst the current chaos.
target: Si pavimento per pavimentum quaereret, certe innumerabilia impedimenta in medio huius chaos occurrent.

source: The mixed‐blood lady’s maid’s expression shifted, revealing a blatant desire and anticipation.
target: Vultus ancillae mulieris sanguine mixti mutatus est, ostendens clarum desiderium ac exspectationem.

source: “She’s sleeping in her room. Third floor, second room facing the rubber forest.”
target: “Dormit in suo conclavi. Tertius tabulatum, secundus conclave ad silvam elasticam spectans.”

source: “Make haste. She’s a vision of beauty, fragrant and pristine. Her figure is exquisite, her skin smooth as silk. She’s a cut above the rest of us. Many a gentleman considers her their dream lover. Go, quickly!”
target: “Festina. Illa est visio pulchritudinis, fragrantia ac pristina. Figura eius exquisita est, et cutis eius lenis ut sericum. Illa prae ceteris excellit. Multi domini eam somnium amoris habere existimant. Vade, celeriter!”

source: As she neared the end of her speech, the mixed‐blood lady’s maid gritted her teeth, her eyes alight with an illusory desire to witness something transpire.
target: Dum ad finem orationis suae accedebat, ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti dentes strinxit, oculis ardentibus cum ficto desiderio aliquid evenire videre.

source: Lugano’s hair stood on end, a chill running down his spine as he confronted the stark malevolence of human nature.
target: Capilli Lugani erexerunt, et frigus per dorsum eius traiecit, dum adversam crudamque malitiam humanam opponebat.

source: Plaudite! Plaudite! Plaudite! Lumian shook his head, a smile playing on his lips as he applauded.
target: Plaudite! Plaudite! Plaudite! Lumian caput concussit, subrisu labris ludenti, plausum faciens.

source: Rhea fell silent for a couple of seconds before rising to her feet and departing the area.
target: Rhea paucos secundos silentium tulit, deinde surrexit et locum reliquum reliquit.

source: After a few steps, she paused, turning to regard the mixed‐blood lady’s maid.
target: Post paucos passus subsistebat et se convertit ad spectandam ancillam mulieris sanguine mixti.

source: In a deep, solemn voice, she reiterated, “Find a secluded spot and hide until dawn.”
target: Voce profunda et solenni iteravit: “Inveni locum solitarium et absconde te usque ad auroram.”

source: With those parting words, Rhea turned away from the mixed‐blood lady’s maid and sprinted back to the steps at the main house’s entrance.
target: His verbis valedictoriis, Rhea a ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti avertit se et celeriter regressa est ad gradus ad ostium domus principalis.

source: Lumian averted his gaze and led the way through the open brown door.
target: Lumian oculos suos avertit et viam duxit per ianuam apertam fuscam.

source: As he, Camus, and the others entered, they were greeted by a startling sight in the living room.
target: Dum ille, Camus, et ceteri intrabant, spectaculum mirum in atrio eis apparuit.

source: A middle‐aged woman in a disheveled nightgown, her half‐exposed body glistening with sweat and her black hair in disarray, sat astride a sturdy native slave.
target: Mulier mediocri aetate, induta nocturnis vestimentis dissolutis, cuius corpus dimidio patefactum sudore micabat et capilli nigri in confusione erant, super firmum servum indigenam sedebat.

source: Her movements were intense, and she appeared utterly immersed, alternating between shouting and cursing.
target: Motus eius vehementes erant, et prorsus immersa apparuit, inter clamores et maledicta alternanter proferens.

source: The native slave, clearly enjoying the experience, eagerly cooperated.
target: Servus indigenus, qui experientiam manifeste fruebatur, vehementer cooperatus est.

source: Near the staircase, a group of five or six servants and slaves, armed with an assortment of shotguns, rifles, and other weapons, intermittently fired bullets up the stairs.
target: Prope scalas, coetus quinque vel sex ministrorum et servorum, variis armis ut sclopetis, tormentis, et aliis instructus, globos intermitte in scalas iecere.

source: Occasional counterattacks emanated from the area leading to the second floor.
target: Interdum impetūs adversarii ex regione quae ad secundum tabulatum ducebat procedebant.

source: Camus stood frozen, his gaze fixed on the middle‐aged woman’s flushed face.
target: Camus stetit immobilis, oculis in facie rubente mulieris mediocri aetate fixa.

source: “You know her?” Lumian asked, a smile playing on his lips.
target: «Notasne eam?» inquit Lumian, subrisu labris ludente.

source: It was Rhea who replied, “She’s Sir Petit’s wife, Miss Amandina’s mother, Madam Simona.”
target: Rhea respondit: “Illa est uxor Domini Petit, mater Dominae Amandinae, domina Simona.”

source: “I never imagined she would be like this…” Camus said, his voice low and somber.
target: «Numquam putavi eam talem esse…» inquit Camus, voce humili et lugubri.

source: Lumian smiled and applauded once more.
target: Lumian subrexit et iterum plausum fecit.

source: “Can’t she indulge in her dreams?
target: “Nonne potest illa somnia sua frui?”

source: “For the Dream Festival, this is something we should encourage. No one is being forced. How delightfully harmless.”
target: “Pro Festival Somniorum, hoc fovere debemus. Nemo cogitur; quam benignum et inermum est!”

source: Camus found himself momentarily at a loss for words.
target: Camus paulisper verba amittere sensit.

source: Lumian then said to Rhea, “During the Dream Festival, there’s a high likelihood that the person you save will also be a bad person and may even attack you.”
target: Lumian deinde Rhea dixit: “Per Festival Somniorum, magna probabilitas est ut persona quam servabis mala sit et fortasse te oppugnet.”

source: Rhea fell silent for a few seconds before responding in a low voice, “Even if something like that happens again, I’ll still save her.”
target: Rhea paulisper silentium tulit, deinde voce humili respondit: “Etiam, si simile iterum eveniat, eam servabo.”

source: Lumian dropped the subject and shifted his attention to Camus.
target: Lumian rem deposuit et animos suos in Camum vertit.

source: “Are you prepared to see the other side of Miss Amandina? Perhaps she will…”
target: «Paratusne es alteram partem Dominae Amandinae videre? Forsitan illa…»

source: Lumian left the sentence unfinished, instead casting a meaningful glance at Madam Simona, who was in the throes of fierce, foul‐mouthed ecstasy.
target: Lumian sententiam incomplete reliquit, et potius aspectum significativum in Domina Simonam dedit, quae in furori acerrimo et obsceno versabatur.

source: Camus exhaled slowly, his voice resolute.
target: Camus lente suspiravit, voce firmissima.

source: “I’m here to save her. It doesn’t matter if she’s good or bad, kind, malicious, chaste, or indulgent.
target: “Adsum ut eam servem. Non refert utrum bona sit an mala, benigna, maligna, casta aut indulgens.

source: “After helping her find a safe hiding place and making sure she waits until dawn, we’ll head to Twanaku’s house.”
target: “Postquam eam adiuvavimus ut locum securum inveniret et curavimus ut usque ad auroram remaneat, ad domum Twanaku properabimus.”

source: I’m here to save her. It doesn’t matter if she’s good or bad, kind, malicious… Lumian quietly repeated the first half of the sentence, a smile playing on his lips as he regarded the servants and slaves attempting to occupy the staircase.
target: “Adsum ut eam servem. Non refert utrum bona sit an mala, benigna aut maligna…”

source: He raised his voice, asking, “Has anyone seen Miss Amandina? Has she come downstairs?”
target: Vox suam attoluit, quaerens: “Num quis Dominae Amandinae vidit? Descenditne?”

source: The servants and slaves turned their attention to Lumian and his companions, swiftly redirecting their firearms.
target: Servi et ministri attentionem in Lumian et socios eius converterunt, et arma sua celeriter remutaverunt.

source: Lumian calmly extended his right hand, making a grabbing motion.
target: Lumian tranquillime dexteram manum extendit, eam arripiendi motu efferens.

source: With this gesture, crimson flames, their hue bordering on white, ignited in the air, forming a curtain that Lumian seemed to snatch from the void.
target: Hoc signo, flammas rubras, quarum color ad album quasi perveniebat, in aere accenderunt atque velut velum formaverunt, quod Lumian quasi e vacuitate rapere videbatur.

source: With a deft grab and push, the fiery curtain abruptly split, transforming into Fire Birds that hurtled towards the shotguns, rifles, and revolvers before they could be properly aimed.
target: Arte callida pugnomine et impetu, velum ignitum subito divisum est, in Aves Ignis convertendum, quae ad sclopetas, tormenta, et revolveros, antequam recte destinari possent, impetu incesserunt.

source: Amidst a series of muffled explosions, the guns dropped from the servants’ and slaves’ hands, clattering to the ground, damaged beyond use.
target: Inter seriem explosionum submurmurantium, arma ex manibus servorum ceciderunt, in terram stridentes, tam laesa ut ultra adhiberi non posset.

source: The servants and slaves themselves suffered only minor burns, their grip on their weapons faltering.
target: Servi et ministri soli parvas ustiones passi sunt, et tenacitas eorum in armis lapsa est.

source: Since advancing to Reaper, Lumian’s mastery over flames had grown. Even without the Lie earring, he could achieve this level of control.
target: Ex quo ad Reaper progressus est, dominantia Lumiani super flammas auxit; etiam sine “Lie” anulo, hunc gradum imperii assequi valerat.

source: Moreover, he hadn’t unleashed his full power. He hadn’t even summoned the blazing white flames in order to minimize the damage.
target: Praeterea, vim suam plenam nondum effudit; neque flammas albas ardentes evocavit, ut damnum minueret.

source: “Now, can we have a civilized conversation?” Lumian smiled at the servants and slaves.
target: “Nunc, possumusne colloqui more civili?” inquit Lumian, servos et ministros aspiciens, ridens.

source: Behind him, crimson Fire Ravens, their color nearly white, materialized, poised to strike at a moment’s notice.
target: Post eum, corvi ignifer rubri, quorum color quasi album videbatur, apparuerunt, parati ad impetum uno momento.

source: An Intisian valet, who seemed to hold some influence among the group, couldn’t conceal his fear as he replied, “Amandina hasn’t come down. Otherwise…”
target: Valet Intisianus, qui inter coetum aliquam auctoritatem habere videbatur, metum celare non potuit, respondens: “Amandina non descendit. Alioquin…”

source: He couldn’t help but lick his lips.
target: Non potuit quin labia lamberet.

source: “And who were you shooting at?” Lumian inquired.
target: “Et ad quem iaciebas?” inquit Lumian.

source: “It’s Petit, that bastard who deserves to rot in hell, and his butler, the one who’s always wielding that damn whip!”
target: “Est Petit, ille scelestus, qui in inferno putredine meretur, et eius minister domesticus, qui semper flagrum istum gerit!”

source: A dark‐skinned slave picked up the fallen firearm, only to discover that it was broken, just like everyone else’s.
target: Servus obscura cute, telum lapsum arripuit, ut inveniret id fractum esse, sicut cetera.

source: They had planned to retrieve more guns from another room on the first floor, but for now, they didn’t dare make a move.
target: Plani erant plura arma ex alio conclave primi tabulati reportare, sed interim non audebant ullo motu agere.

source: “Is that so?” Lumian nodded, a look of enlightenment crossing his features. “Carry on, then.”
target: “Ita vero?” inquit Lumian, annuens, vultu illustrato. “Igitur pergite.”

source: He turned around, leading the ten to twenty Fire Ravens that had gradually dispersed, and said to Camus and the others,
target: Conversus est, ducens decem ad viginti Corvos Igniferos, qui paulatim dissersi erant, et ad Camum et ceteros dixit:

source: “Let’s scale the side of the building to reach the third floor.”
target: «Ascendamus latus aedificii ad tertium tabulatum pervenienda.»

source: Teleportation wasn’t an optimal option at this distance, not after having used it four times already.
target: Teleportatio optio optima non erat ad hanc distantiam, postquam iam quater usus erat.

source: Of course, since advancing to Reaper, Lumian could now perform 11 to 12 Spirit World Traversals without relying on the spirituality accumulated through his Ascetic abilities. It was a marked improvement from his previous limitations.
target: Certus est, ex quo ad Reaper progressus est, Lumian nunc undecim ad duodecim itinera per Mundi Spiritualem conficere poterat, sine fiducia in spiritu ex facultatibus asceticis acquisito; id evidens melioratio erat prae priore limitatione eius.

source: Camus and the others raised no objections.
target: Camus et ceteri nullas objectiones fecerunt.

source: Lugano, however, trembled as he asked, “H-how am I supposed to climb?”
target: Lugano, autem, tremens quaesivit: “Quomodo ascendere debeam?”

source: He swung the stump that was all that remained of his right arm.
target: Ille truncum, quod de brachio dextro eius solum superesset, verberavit.

source: Lumian glanced at him and said matter-of-factly, “Camus will assist you.”
target: Lumian eum intuens inquit: “Camus tibi auxiliabitur.”

source: Me? Camus was momentarily taken aback before assessing his own skills and concluding that it was indeed feasible.
target: “Me?” Camus paulisper obstupefactus est, deinde facultates suas aestimans conclususque est hoc vere fieri posse.

source: Before long, the four of them had ascended to the third floor, making use of the statues, decorations, metal pipes, and side balcony adorning the outer wall.
target: Mox quattuor simul ad tertium tabulatum ascendere potuerunt, utens statuis, ornamentis, fistulis metallicis, et balcone laterali qui murum exterius ornabant.

source: As soon as Camus pushed open the door leading to the corridor, he caught sight of a figure.
target: Statim ut Camus ostium ad corridor aperuit, figuram deprehendit.

source: It was Amandina’s personal maid, an Intisian lady’s maid clad in a white cloth nightgown.
target: Illa erat ancilla privata Amandinae, ancilla Intisiana, in nocturnis vestimentis albis induta.

source: At that moment, the young lady’s maid stood bathed in the dim moonlight, a bloody dagger clutched in her hand, her expression inscrutable.
target: In illo momento, ancilla iuvenis sub obscura luce lunari stabat, pugionem sanguine tinctum in manu tenens, vultu arcano.

source: Drip. Drip. The bright red blood from the dagger fell onto the corridor carpet, each drop a vivid splash of color.
target: Gutta. Gutta. Sanguis ruber ex pugione in tapete corridoris cecidit, singula gutta vividum colorem effundens.

source: Camus’s heart clenched.
target: Cor Camus contraxum est.

source: “What have you done?”
target: “Quid egisti?”

source: The lady’s maid’s face broke into a satisfied, carefree smile.
target: Facies ancillae effusa est in risum laetum atque levem.

source: “I killed it. I’ve been annoyed by it for far too long!”
target: “Occidi id; nimis diu ab eo molestata sum!”

source: It? In Intisian, “she” and “it” were two entirely different words.
target: Id? In Intisiano, “illa” et “id” erant duo prorsus diversa verba.

source: Amidst his surprise, Camus followed the trail of dripping blood, his gaze falling upon Amandina’s beloved pet dog, lying motionless at the door of the adjacent room.
target: Inter stuporem suum, Camus vestigia sanguinis stillantis secutus est, et oculos suos ad canem carissimum Amandinae, qui immotus ad ostium cubiculi vicini iacebat, direxit.

source: Phew… Camus breathed a sigh of relief before asking in a deep, serious voice, “Where’s Miss Amandina?”
target: Phew… Camus lento suspiro levato, voce profunda et seria quaesivit: “Ubi est Domina Amandina?”

source: The lady’s maid’s expression turned resentful.
target: Vultus ancillae iracunditatem ostendit.

source: “I’m looking for her too! She left an hour ago!”
target: “Etiam quaero eam! Abiit abhinc horam!”

source: An hour ago… Before the Dream Festival began?
target: Abhinc horam… Ante incipiendum Festival Somniorum?

source: Camus pressed further, “Where did she go?”
target: Camus ulterius quaesivit: “Quo abiit?”

source: The lady’s maid, still holding the blood‐stained dagger, replied with a contorted expression, “She went on a date with my Robert!”
target: Ancilla, adhuc pugione sanguine maculato tenens, vultu contorto respondit: “Illam cum Roberto meo in colloquium ivisse!”

source: Camus fell silent.
target: Camus silentium ceperat.

source: Lumian shook his head.
target: Lumian caput concussit.

source: Under the watchful eyes of the lady’s maid, who yearned to kill but felt outnumbered, he swiftly searched the entire third floor with Rhea and the others, but found no trace of Amandina.
target: Sub oculis vigilibus ancillae, quae occidere cupiebat sed se minore numero sentiebat, celeriter totum tertium tabulatum cum Rhea et ceteris perquisivit, sed nullum vestigium Amandinae invenit.

source: “Let’s go.” Lumian turned to Camus, his voice firm.
target: “Eamus.” inquit Lumian ad Camum, voce firma.

source: Camus had no choice but to concede defeat.
target: Camus nullam aliam optionem habuit nisi cladem agnoscere.

source: The four of them immediately teleported outside Hisoka’s house.
target: Quattuor simul statim extra domum Hisoka teleportaverunt.

source: Just as Lumian was about to proceed, he sensed something and looked up at the third floor.
target: Modo dum Lumian procedere parabat, aliquid sensit et ad tertium tabulatum aspexit.

source: A face appeared through the glass window of a room on the third floor.
target: Vultus per fenestram vitrei conclavi in tertio tabulato apparuit.

source: The face was graced with a high nose bridge, piercing blue eyes, and thick black hair tied into a simple knot atop her head. Her brows exuded a youthful, vibrant aura.
target: Vultus ornatissimus habebat pontem nasi altum, oculos caeruleos acutos, et capillos nigerrimos crassos in nodo simplici in summitate capitis alligatos; supercilia ejus aerem iuvenilem et vibrantem praebebant.

source: Amandina!
target: Amandina!

source: It was said that Amandina had gone on a date with her fiancé, Robert!
target: Diceretur Amandinam cum sponsulo suo, Roberto, in colloquium ivisse!
